criteria.rationale: Schema stays v1; the update changed only engine_version 6.0.0 to 6.0.4 and left policies, ledger, profiles and the scaffold template POSE.md untouched.
No engine code changed in this scope; the sealed build and the full native matrix pass at this revision, and the only change is the engine_version stamp, which the strict check reads and accepts.
The spec records why the stamp lagged four releases, the authenticated binary, the single-line change and the idempotent repeat.
The native update repeated without drift and the strict check passes; the instance now reports the engine it runs.
R1 and R2 are verified by the native update and its repeat recorded in the spec; R3 by the strict check. The sealed unit run covers the engine that performs the update, unchanged by this scope.
Two paths: the machinery manifest stamp and the adoption spec.
The global CLI ran only after the v6.0.4 archive digest and Sigstore identity matched the verified ledger and the binary equalled the independent rebuild; no policy or trust setting changed.
